summary: Relay Therapeutics filed an 8-K furnishing a press release and slide presentation on April 27, 2026, disclosing Phase 1/2 clinical data for its triplet combination (zovegalisib, fulvestrant, atirmociclib) in PI3K-mutated breast cancer and announcing plans to advance the regimen into Phase 3 development. The filing reports safety and efficacy data from 69 patients as of April 13, 2026, with a median follow-up of 7.4 months. No corporate transaction, structural change, or special situation is described. The filing is a routine clinical-update disclosure under Items 7.01 and 8.01.
